If Settings → Network → Private DNS is set to a provider hostname, Android skips this filter. Set it to Off or Automatic.

PrivacyGuard uses a local VPN to filter website lookups on this phone. Lookups for known tracking and ad domains are blocked; all others go to your normal DNS server.\n\nNothing is sent to us, and no data leaves your phone because of this app.
